points.title: 童年成长
points.description: 罗纳德·里根1911年2月6日出生于伊利诺伊州狄克特的一个普通家庭。父亲是鞋店推销员，母亲是家庭主妇。童年时期，里根家境并不富裕，但父母教导他勤奋工作和诚实守信的价值观。他在狄克特高中时期展现出演讲才能，担任校报编辑和学生会主席，并参与校戏剧表演。这段经历培养了他日后作为演说家的基础，也塑造了他对美国的乐观态度。
points.descriptionEn: Ronald Reagan was born on February 6, 1911, in Dixon, Illinois, to a middle-class family. His father worked as a shoe salesman, and his mother was a homemaker. Though not wealthy, his parents instilled values of hard work and honesty in him. During his high school years in Dixon, Reagan developed his oratory skills, serving as editor of the school newspaper, student body president, and participating in drama productions. These experiences laid the foundation for his future career as a speaker and shaped his optimistic American outlook.

points.title: 大学时期
points.description: 里根进入伊利诺伊州尤里卡学院学习经济学和社会学，同时积极参与校园活动。他担任学生会主席，并展现出对体育的热爱，特别是游泳和橄榄球。大学期间，他通过兼职工作支付学费，包括担任救生员和广播播音员。这段经历培养了他的工作伦理和沟通能力，为他日后进入媒体行业奠定了基础。1932年毕业时，他已展现出领导才能和公众演讲的天赋。
points.descriptionEn: Reagan attended Eureka College in Illinois, studying economics and sociology while actively participating in campus activities. He served as student body president and developed a passion for sports, particularly swimming and football. During college, he worked part-time jobs to pay tuition, including as a lifeguard and radio announcer. These experiences cultivated his work ethic and communication skills, laying the foundation for his future media career. Upon graduation in 1932, he had already demonstrated leadership abilities and talent for public speaking.

points.title: 演艺生涯
points.description: 里根移居好莱坞，开始了他的演艺生涯。他最初在华纳兄弟公司签约，出演了超过50部电影，包括《克努特·罗克尼》(Knute Rockne, All American)、《国王班底》(King's Row)等。他在《克努特·罗克尼》中饰演的乔治·吉普一角使他成为明星，并留下著名的台词'赢得比赛只是胜利，但努力奋斗才是成功'。二战期间，他因视力问题未能参军，但制作了数百部军事训练影片。这段演艺生涯使他成为公众人物，并培养了他对媒体和公众舆论的理解。
points.descriptionEn: Reagan moved to Hollywood and began his acting career. Initially signed with Warner Bros., he appeared in over 50 films, including 'Knute Rockne, All American' and 'King's Row.' His portrayal of George Gipp in 'Knute Rockne' made him a star and introduced the famous line 'Winning just isn't enough, it's the struggle that counts.' During World War II, he was exempt from military service due to poor eyesight but produced hundreds of military training films. This acting career established him as a public figure and developed his understanding of media and public opinion.

points.title: 工会领袖
points.description: 里根从1947年开始担任美国演员工会(Screen Actors Guild)主席，并在1950年代多次担任此职。在麦卡锡主义盛行的时期，他作为工会领袖调查好莱坞的共产主义渗透，同时保持相对温和的立场。他最初支持好莱坞黑名单政策，但后来逐渐反对过度限制。这段经历使他接触到了政治斗争，并形成了对个人自由和反共的坚定立场。作为工会领袖，他学会了谈判技巧和领导艺术，这些技能后来成为他政治生涯的重要资产。
points.descriptionEn: Reagan served as president of the Screen Actors Guild from 1947 to 1952, and again in the 1950s. During the height of McCarthyism, he investigated communist infiltration in Hollywood as union leader while maintaining a relatively moderate stance. Initially supportive of Hollywood's blacklist policy, he later came to oppose excessive restrictions. This experience exposed him to political struggles and shaped his firm positions on individual freedom and anti-communism. As a union leader, he developed negotiation skills and leadership abilities that became valuable assets in his political career.

points.place: 加利福尼亚州萨克拉门托
points.title: 加州州长
points.description: 里根于1967年当选为加州州长，并在1970年成功连任。作为州长，他推行了福利改革，削减税收，并增加了州政府支出。他最初支持堕胎权，后来转变为反对立场。1970年，他派遣国民警卫队镇压加州大学伯克利分校的反战示威。他还任命了更多女性和少数族裔担任政府职位。在加州的八年任期，他建立了保守派政治形象，为后来的总统竞选奠定了基础。他的治理风格强调有限政府和个人责任，这些理念成为他政治哲学的核心。
points.descriptionEn: Reagan was elected Governor of California in 1967 and won re-election in 1970. As governor, he implemented welfare reforms, cut taxes, and increased state spending. He initially supported abortion rights but later opposed them. In 1970, he deployed the National Guard to suppress anti-war protests at UC Berkeley. He also appointed more women and minorities to government positions. His eight-year tenure in California established his conservative political image and laid the foundation for his later presidential campaigns. His governing style emphasized limited government and personal responsibility, which became central to his political philosophy.

points.title: 美国总统
points.description: 里根于1981年就任美国第40任总统，并在1984年以压倒性优势连任。他的总统任期内推行了'里根经济学'，包括大规模减税、放松管制和削减社会福利。他提出了'星球大战'战略防御计划，大幅增加国防开支，导致冷战后期美苏军备竞赛加剧。1983年，他下令入侵格林纳达；1986年，他发动了对利比亚的空袭。1987年，他与苏联领导人戈尔巴乔夫签署了《中程核力量条约》。尽管面临伊朗门丑闻，他的支持率依然保持高位。里根的总统任期重塑了美国政治格局，结束了冷战，并影响了全球政治经济格局。
points.descriptionEn: Reagan was inaugurated as the 40th U.S. President in 1981 and won re-election in 1984 by a landslide. His presidency implemented 'Reaganomics,' featuring massive tax cuts, deregulation, and reduced social welfare. He proposed the Strategic Defense Initiative ('Star Wars') and significantly increased defense spending, intensifying the Cold War arms race. In 1983, he ordered the invasion of Grenada; in 1986, he launched airstrikes against Libya. In 1987, he signed the Intermediate-Range Nuclear Forces Treaty with Soviet leader Gorbachev. Despite the Iran-Contra scandal, his approval ratings remained high. Reagan's presidency reshaped American politics, ended the Cold War, and influenced global political and economic landscapes.

supporter.zh: 支持者认为里根是美国历史上最伟大的总统之一，他重振了美国经济，结束了冷战，恢复了国家自信。他的减税政策释放了市场活力，他的强硬外交立场迫使苏联改革。里根被视为美国梦的化身，从普通家庭到好莱坞明星再到总统的传奇人生激励了无数人。他的乐观主义精神和坚定的价值观被视为美国精神的代表，他的遗产包括保守主义运动的重塑和共和党的现代化。
supporter.en: Supporters consider Reagan one of America's greatest presidents, revitalizing the economy, ending the Cold War, and restoring national confidence. His tax cuts unleashed market vitality, and his tough diplomatic stance forced Soviet reforms. Reagan is seen as the embodiment of the American Dream, inspiring countless people with his journey from humble beginnings to Hollywood star to president. His optimism and firm values represent the American spirit, with his legacy including the reshaping of conservatism and the modernization of the Republican Party.

critic.zh: 批评者指出里根的政策加剧了贫富差距，社会福利削减导致弱势群体困境。他的外交政策被视为鲁莽和危险，如'星球大战'计划加剧了军备竞赛，中美洲干预被批评为侵犯主权。伊朗门丑闻暴露了其政府的不道德行为。批评者认为他的经济政策导致巨额国债，而他对环境问题的忽视造成了长期生态损害。此外，他在种族问题上的立场被批评为不够积极，对艾滋病危机的初期反应也受到质疑。
critic.en: Critics argue that Reagan's policies widened the wealth gap, with welfare cuts causing hardship for vulnerable populations. His foreign policy is viewed as reckless and dangerous, with the 'Star Wars' program escalating the arms race and Central American interventions criticized as violations of sovereignty. The Iran-Contra scandal exposed unethical behavior in his administration. Critics contend his economic policies led to massive national debt, while his neglect of environmental issues caused long-term ecological damage. Additionally, his stance on racial issues is criticized as insufficient, and his early response to the AIDS crisis is questioned.

objective.zh: 历史学界普遍认为里根是一位转型性总统，他重塑了美国政治格局和保守主义运动。他的经济政策虽然争议巨大，但确实改变了美国经济模式。在外交领域，他既被视为冷战的终结者，也被批评为军备竞赛的加剧者。里根的形象在流行文化中被高度符号化，成为保守主义的象征，同时也被广泛模仿和引用。他的演讲技巧和沟通能力被广泛认可，能够有效传达复杂理念。历史评价趋向于承认他的历史影响力，同时承认其政策的复杂性和两面性。
objective.en: Historians generally view Reagan as a transformative president who reshaped American politics and conservatism. His economic policies, though highly controversial, significantly altered America's economic model. In foreign affairs, he is seen both as the Cold War's ender and its arms race intensifier. Reagan's image has become highly symbolic in popular culture, representing conservatism while also being widely imitated and quoted. His oratory skills and communication abilities are widely recognized for effectively conveying complex ideas. Historical assessments tend to acknowledge his significant impact while recognizing the complexity and dual nature of his policies.

self.zh: 政府不是解决问题的方法，政府本身就是问题。
self.en: Government is not the solution to our problem; government is the problem.

others.zh: 里根不是一位普通的总统，他是一位改变了世界的人。
others.en: Reagan was no ordinary president; he was a man who changed the world.
